# Skeleton — sukuna-ui

> A placeholder shimmer shown while content loads.

- **Package:** `sukuna-ui` v0.5.0 — `bun add sukuna-ui` (or `npm i sukuna-ui`)
- **Import:** `import { Skeleton } from 'sukuna-ui'`
- **Styles:** `@import "sukuna-ui/theme.css"` (Tailwind v4) or `import "sukuna-ui/styles.css"` (no Tailwind) — see [Getting started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/main/llms.txt)
- **Source:** https://github.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/tree/main/src/components/skeleton · **Spec:** https://github.com/arielplas/sukuna-ui/blob/main/docs/component-skeleton.md

## Purpose

A placeholder shimmer shown while content loads.

## API

```ts
import type { ComponentPropsWithoutRef } from 'react'

export interface SkeletonProps extends ComponentPropsWithoutRef<'div'> {
  variant?: 'text' | 'rectangular' | 'circular'   // default 'rectangular'
  // size comes from your className/style (e.g. className="h-4 w-40")
}
```

## Variants & tokens

Base: `animate-pulse bg-surface-2`. text → `rounded-sm h-[1em]`; rectangular → `rounded-md`;
circular → `rounded-full`.

## States

Static; always pulsing while mounted.

## Accessibility

- [ ] Decorative (`aria-hidden`); convey loading via a container `aria-busy`/`role="status"`.
